cards.heading: VLM document parsing: definition
cards.question: What does vision-language document parsing replace, and what does it do instead?
cards.answer: It replaces the conventional pipeline of layout detection, OCR, and post-processing scripts with a single model that takes the page image as one input and emits structured content directly.

cards.heading: Why staged OCR pipelines fail on complex layouts
cards.question: Why do classical layout-then-OCR pipelines characteristically fail on multi-column layouts, nested tables, and formulas?
cards.answer: Each stage's errors are inherited by the next with no route back, and correct reading order is a global property of the page that a region-by-region process has already discarded by the time it reassembles the document.

cards.heading: How a VLM resolves a page in one pass
cards.question: How does a vision-language model process a document page differently from a staged pipeline?
cards.answer: It treats the whole image as one modality and generates structured output in one pass, so layout, text and semantics are resolved together rather than sequentially.

cards.heading: VLM parsing's failure mode: hallucination
cards.question: What new failure mode does vision-language parsing introduce compared to classical OCR, and why is it more dangerous?
cards.answer: A generative model can produce fluent text that was never on the page. A hallucinated figure in a parsed invoice or lab result is more dangerous than a garbled one because it carries no visible sign of error.

cards.heading: When to use VLM parsing vs deterministic OCR
cards.question: What decision rule determines whether to use a unified vision-language model or deterministic OCR for document parsing?
cards.answer: Low error tolerance argues for deterministic recognition or a hybrid that checks generated output against it; high-volume ingestion of messy documents is where replacing the pipeline pays off.

cards.heading: What made VLM parsing practical at volume
cards.question: What practical shift made vision-language document parsing viable for high-volume use rather than a research demonstration?
cards.answer: Purpose-trained open models in this class became small and efficient enough to run at volume.
